284241344.description:
Parker
Lucite and Metal Fountain Pen
Mid-Century Modern, Circa 1940s-1950s
This vintage Parker "51" fountain pen features the model's signature streamlined silhouette, introduced originally in 1941 to revolutionize writing instruments. The design highlights a tapered black barrel, an integrated hooded nib assembly, and a brushed metal lustraloy-style slip-on cap with an arrow clip. It comes housed in its vintage clamshell presentation box lined with satin and fitted card stock.
Parker "51" aerodynamic design with hooded nib and streamlined profile
Black resin/lucite barrel with brushed metal cap and silver-tone arrow pocket clip
Marked "51" and "Parker" on inner presentation case insert
Includes hinged presentation box measuring approximately 5.6 inches in length
Condition:
Vintage condition with age-appropriate cosmetic wear. Barrel and hood show light surface micro-scratching consistent with handling and use. Cap retains its clip firmly and seats securely. Box exterior exhibits scuffs, edge wear, and surface rubbing; interior card shows vintage handwriting in ink across the lower bezel. Untested for ink filling and writing functionality.

284327348.description: This set includes six vintage smoking pipes made from briar wood, each featuring black plastic or vulcanite stems. The collection displays a variety of classic bowl shapes and stem designs, including one with a decorative bent stem. Markings on the pipes show origins such as Made in Denmark, Imported Briar, and Signature Imported Briar. The pipes vary in color from medium to reddish brown and show light wear while remaining structurally sound.

284327183.description: This listing features three vintage hand-carved briar wood tobacco pipe bowls made in Denmark by Refbjerg. The set includes one smooth polished bowl, one rusticated textured bowl, and one classic rounded smooth bowl, each showing natural wood grain patterns in a rich brown color. The pipes have darkening inside the bowls indicative of prior use and come without stems. They are in good vintage condition with minor wear consistent with their age.

This lot contains a variety of tumbled and raw gemstones and minerals displayed spilling from a cardboard box. The stones present multiple colors including green, pink, orange, white, black, and blue, with polished and rough textures and patterns.
